title: Allow app icons dropped into panel spacers adjacent to task manager to be added to task manager
line: Dropping an app on a spacer next to the task manager now pins it in the task manager instead of adding a separate icon widget.
explanation: The panel containment handled every drop the same way: an application dropped on empty spacer space became its own Icon widget, even when a task manager sat right next to that spacer, so the app could not be reordered with the pinned ones. The panel now checks where the drop lands: if the drop is on a spacer whose neighbour (directly, or just past the spacer) is a task manager and every dropped URL is an application, it adds them as task manager launchers, at the start if the spacer is before the task manager and at the end if after. Anything else (files, widgets, no adjacent task manager) goes through the old path.

commits.message:
containments/panel: add apps dropped on a spacer to the nearby task manager

Dropping an application on a spacer next to the task manager added it as
a separate icon widget, which is rarely what's wanted. Such drops now pin
the app in the task manager, at the end that faces the drop point.

BUG: 507822

media.caption: Dragging Discover from Kickoff onto the spacer left of the task manager adds a separate icon widget next to Kickoff
The same drag now pins Discover at the start of the task manager
Result before: Discover is its own widget, apart from the task manager
Result after: Discover is the first launcher in the task manager
